name: Bắc Ninh

queries.query: Bắc Ninh official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS Vietnam
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Bắc Ninh provincial public land-information GIS portal (Hệ thống CSDL Dùng Chung tỉnh Bắc Ninh), which advertises public land-information lookup and planning applications. The portal timed out during bounded direct retrieval; no parcel response was obtained. Official provincial reporting also describes cadastral mapping and land-database work, but is general status evidence rather than a parcel endpoint.

queries.query: Bắc Ninh bản đồ địa chính đất đai tra cứu thông tin đất đai chính thức
queries.result: Tìm kiếm nguồn chính thức xác định Hệ thống CSDL Dùng Chung tỉnh Bắc Ninh có ứng dụng công khai tra cứu thông tin đất đai và quy hoạch. Yêu cầu GET ẩn danh có giới hạn tới cổng GIS bị timeout; không nhận được cấu hình JavaScript, API, lược đồ, CRS, mã thửa an toàn hoặc hình học. Cổng thông tin tỉnh xác nhận công tác đo đạc, lập bản đồ địa chính và xây dựng cơ sở dữ liệu đất đai, nhưng đây không phải phản hồi thửa đất.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: Ủy ban nhân dân tỉnh Bắc Ninh and its provincial public GIS/land-information system are evidenced. The official provincial portal advertises public land-information lookup; the provincial government site reports cadastral-map and land-database work. No city-specific registry office endpoint was qualified.
officialSourceAssessment.publicLandMapService: Bắc Ninh shared GIS at https://gis.bacninh.gov.vn/BacGiangHome/index.html; planning/land-information application at https://gis.bacninh.gov.vn/QuyHoach/.
officialSourceAssessment.nationalMapService: Vietnam Ministry/land-data map portal discovered at https://maps.gdla.gov.vn/; no Bắc Ninh parcel response was obtained.
officialSourceAssessment.registryBasis: A first-party provincial public land-information GIS and official provincial cadastral-data reporting support registryFound=true for source discovery only. This does not qualify an adapter or establish citywide parcel coverage.
officialSourceAssessment.registryFoundReason: Official Bắc Ninh GIS explicitly advertises public land-information lookup and is operated under the provincial government identity; direct parcel inspection remained unavailable.

schemaAndCrs.inspectionNote: Bounded anonymous GET to the official GIS timed out before HTML, JavaScript, service configuration, schema, CRS, or parcel data could be retrieved. No safe ID-plus-geometry response was obtained. Vietnamese legal guidance identifies VN-2000 as the national cadastral reference system in general, but it was not observed in a Bắc Ninh service response and is not asserted as this service's CRS.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Not executed against a qualified parcel endpoint; exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Bắc Ninh provincial public land-information GIS and national land-data map discovery.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official service identity and provincial cadastral-data context only; no parcel geometry, map extent, or citywide coverage.

Bắc Ninh-specific parcel access, native identity, schema, CRS, safe geometry, and citywide coverage remain unverified.
